Privacy Policy

This site is built to work with as little data as possible. There are no cookies, ads or visitor tracking, and no third-party scripts are loaded.

In short

  • No cookies, analytics, advertising or social media tracking code.
  • Everything, including fonts, is served from this site, so your visit is not reported to third parties such as Google Fonts.
  • Your details are processed only if you fill in the contact form or send an email; see the KVKK Information Notice for the details.

Data controller

Eray Ulusoy, [POSTA ADRESİ / POSTAL ADDRESS] · contact@erayulusoy.com

When you visit the site

The site is hosted on the infrastructure of Cloudflare, Inc. (USA). To deliver pages to you and protect the site from attacks, Cloudflare briefly processes technical data such as your IP address, browser details and the time of the request. These records are not given to me as a visitor profile and I do not use them to track anyone.

When you switch language (EN / TR), your choice is saved only in your own browser’s local storage and is never sent to a server. You can clear it at any time in your browser settings.

Contact form and email

The name, email, company, service and message you enter in the form are delivered to me by email through Formspree, Inc. (USA) and used only to reply to your enquiry. Before sending, the form asks for your consent to this transfer abroad; if you would rather not give it, write directly to contact@erayulusoy.com. Retention, recipients and your rights are explained in the KVKK Information Notice.

Links to other sites

When you follow a link to another site, such as LinkedIn, that site’s own privacy policy applies.

Visitors from the European Union

If you are in the EU or EEA, your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) also apply. Form data is processed to answer you and take pre-contract steps (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), on the basis of legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)), and transferred abroad on the basis of your consent (Art. 49(1)(a)). You may complain to the data protection authority in your country.

Security

The site is served only over encrypted connections (HTTPS) and protected by strict security headers. No method of transmission is entirely without risk, so please do not send sensitive information through the form.

Changes

This policy is updated when needed. The current version is always on this page, with the date of the last update below.

Contact

For any privacy question: contact@erayulusoy.com
